title: Wakanda Forever
description: Become the protector of Wakanda. Craft Vibranium gear, consume the Heart-Shaped Herb, and unleash kinetic pulses to defend your world.
body:
🛡️ Wakanda Forever: The Vibranium Mod

Become the protector of your world.

Wakanda Forever brings the advanced technology and mystical traditions of Wakanda to Minecraft. This isn't just a gear mod—it's a complete combat overhaul centered around the legendary metal, Vibranium.
⚡ Key Features

    Kinetic Absorption: Your Vibranium Suit absorbs the energy of every blow you take. Once charged, unleash a Kinetic Pulse [V] to send your enemies flying!

    Advanced Sensors: Use the suit's integrated HUD [G] to reveal nearby threats through walls with Wakandan tracking technology.

    The Heart-Shaped Herb: Seek out Apprentice Farmers to obtain the sacred herb. Consume it to transcend human limits with massive boosts to speed, strength, and vision.

    Vibranium Arsenal: Craft high-durability Spears, Shields, and Kimoyo Beads to complete your loadout.

    Deep World Integration: Mine Vibranium Ore in the deepest reaches of the Overworld (Y 0 to -64) and process it using high-heat Blast Furnaces.
